query.description: When true, creates a new GitHub repository instead of linking an existing one

optional.name: display_name

optional.description: Environment to associate

optional.description: Agent to use as fallback

Updates a project.

optional.description: Agent readiness status as reported by the container

optional.name: stream_url
optional.description: URL for live container output streaming

optional.description: Git SHA currently checked out in the container

optional.description: Commit message for the deployed SHA

attributes.description: Lists tasks for the current account. Filterable by project and full-text search.

query.name: project_id
query.description: Filter tasks belonging to this project

query.name: query
query.description: Full-text search on title and description

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Task kind name (e.g. feature, debugging, planning)

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current pipeline stage name (e.g. pending, implementing, reviewing)

attributes.name: depends_on
attributes.description: IDs of tasks this task depends on
Creates a task in a project.

required.name: project_id
required.description: ID of the project to create the task in

required.name: kind
required.description: Task kind name (e.g. feature, debugging, planning, bootstrap, evaluation, repair)

optional.name: description
optional.description: Detailed task description (required when kind is debugging, planning, or repair)

optional.name: depends_on
optional.description: Array of task IDs this task depends on

422.description: Validation failed (missing required field, invalid project, bad dependency IDs)

attributes.description: Returns a single task.
Updates a task's implementation/verification criteria or token usage counts.

optional.name: implementation_criteria
optional.description: Implementation plan written by the planning agent

optional.name: verification_criteria
optional.description: Verification steps for the implementing agent

optional.name: input_tokens
optional.description: Cumulative input token count

optional.name: output_tokens
optional.description: Cumulative output token count

attributes.description: Fetches Loki log lines for the task's container. Supports time-range or duration-based queries.

query.name: duration
query.description: Look back this many minutes (mutually exclusive with start/end)

query.name: start
query.description: ISO8601 start time for the log window

query.name: end
query.description: ISO8601 end time for the log window

200.description: Log lines and query metadata. Not JSON:API format.

attributes.name: logs
attributes.description: Array of log line strings

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: Echo of the query parameters used
Lists recordings (asciinema, rrweb) attached to a task.

200.description: List of recordings. Not paginated JSON:API — returns a flat data array.

attributes.description: Uploads a new recording for a task.

optional.name: recording_type
optional.description: Type: asciinema or rrweb

optional.name: started_at
optional.description: ISO8601 timestamp

optional.name: ended_at
optional.description: ISO8601 timestamp

optional.name: file
optional.description: Recording file upload

attributes.description: Returns a single recording.
Streams the raw content of an asciinema recording.

200.description: Raw recording bytes (application/json or appropriate MIME type). Not JSON:API format.

422.description: Recording type does not support content streaming

attributes.description: Serves an image file attached to a task.
Marks a task stage complete (legacy completion endpoint). Prefer /stage_completion.

optional.name: result
optional.description: passed or failed

attributes.description: Advances a task through its pipeline. Handles gated stages, failure rework, empty-diff guards, and unpushed-commit checks.

optional.name: result
optional.description: passed (default) or failed

optional.name: message
optional.description: Free-form progress comment posted to the task

optional.name: summary
optional.description: Context for the next stage, recorded on the transition

optional.name: flow_run_ids
optional.description: Flow run IDs to associate with this transition

optional.name: noop_reason
optional.description: Justification for advancing with no code changes

optional.name: local_head_sha
optional.description: Container's local HEAD SHA; blocks if differs from remote branch

optional.name: working_tree_clean
optional.description: If false, blocks advancement (uncommitted changes present)

200.description: Stage advance result. Not JSON:API format.

attributes.description: Reports a bootstrap recipe failure. Blocks the task and records the failure details.

optional.name: failed_step
optional.description: Name of the bootstrap step that failed

optional.name: exit_code
optional.description: Exit code returned by the failed step

422.description: Task already in a terminal state

attributes.description: Creates the task's GitHub pull request if it doesn't exist yet; returns the existing PR if it does (idempotent).

optional.name: input_tokens
optional.description: Optional token counter update
